en: A black‑and‑white view of a cobblestone town square with a circular fountain in the foreground and several 2–3 story historic buildings with gabled roofs in the background. Shop signs in German are visible on the facades, including an inn, a fish hall, a bakery, and a tannery. A horse‑drawn carriage stands at the left, and a single child or small figure is walking near the center of the square.
